from collections import defaultdict
def analyze(name):
    gi=G[name+' input']; gO=G[name+' output']
    chg=[(i,j) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]!=gO[i][j]]

        r0=min(r for r,_ in c); c0=min(cc for _,cc in c)

    for c in cs:

    g_key=norm(chgc)
    memb=groups[g_key]
    print('   changed-group colors:',[m[0] for m in memb],'sizes',[len(m[1]) for m in memb])

def solve(g,bg=2):
    cs=comps(g)
    cntc=Counter(c[0] for c in cs)
    anchors=[c for c in cs if cntc[c[0]]==1 and len(c[1])>1]
    anchors.sort(key=lambda c:-len(c[1])); anc=anchors[0]
    sh=normsh(anc[1]); tgt=anc[0]
    bysh=defaultdict(list)
    for c in cs: bysh[normsh(c[1])].append(c)
    chgc=None
    # pick group with max overlap count >1, then farthest from anchor
    best=0
    for k,v in bysh.items():
        if len(v)>1:
            ds=[abs(min(r for r,_ in c[1])-min(r for r,_ in anc[1]))+abs(min(c for _,c in c[1])-min(c for _,c in anc[1])) for c in v]
            mx=max(ds); n=sum(1 for d in ds if d==mx)
            if n==1:
                chgc=ds.index(mx)+1
                return grid_targ(g,tgt,chgc)
            if n>best:
                best=n; chgc_idx=ds.index(mx)
    # fallback: just the farthest from anchor among all comps sharing anchor shape
    if chgc is None:
        cand=[c for c in cs if normsh(c[1])==sh]
        ds=sorted((-(abs(min(r for r,_ in c[1])-min(r for r,_ in anc[1]))+abs(min(c for _,c in c[1])-min(c for _,c in anc[1]))),min(r for r,_ in c[1]),min(c for _,c in c[1]),c) for c in cand)
        chgc=cand[0] if cand else None
    return grid_targ(g,tgt,chgc)
def grid_targ(g,tgt,idx):
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if idx is None: return out
    cs=[c for i,c in enumerate(comps(g)) if i==idx]
    if cs: c=cs[0]
    else: return out
    for r,cc in c[1]: out[r][cc]=tgt
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[name+' input']; go=G[name+' output']
    pred=solve(gi)
    print(name,'match:',pred==go)

def solve(g,bg=2):
    cs=comps(g)
    cnt=Counter(c[0] for c in cs)
    anchors=[c for c in cs if cnt[c[0]]==1 and len(c[1])>1]
    anchors.sort(key=lambda c:-len(c[1])); anc=anchors[0]; tgt=anc[0]
    # group all comps by normshape; keep groups with >=2 members
    bysh=defaultdict(list)
    for c in cs: bysh[normsh(c[1])].append(c)
    # remove groups that contain the anchor
    groups=[v for v in bysh.values() if len(v)>=2 and anc not in v and len(set(x[0] for x in v))>=2]
    if not groups: return None
    def dist(c): return abs(min(r for r,_ in c[1])-min(r for r,_ in anc[1]))+abs(min(cc for _,cc in c[1])-min(cc for _,cc in anc[1]))
    chgc=max(groups,key=lambda v:max(dist(c) for c in v))[0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,cc in chgc[1]: out[r][cc]=tgt
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[name+' input']; go=G[name+' output']
    p=solve(gi)
    print(name,'match:',p==go)
print('test result:')

p=solve(G['Test input'])
if p: print(json.dumps(p)); raise SystemExit

def solve(g,bg=2):
    cs=comps(g)
    cnt=Counter(c[0] for c in cs)
    anch=[c for c in cs if cnt[c[0]]==1 and len(c[1])>1]
    anch.sort(key=lambda c:-len(c[1])); anc=anch[0]; tgt=anc[0]
    A=top(anc)
    shs=defaultdict(list)
    for c in cs: shs[normsh(c[1])].append(c)
    grps=[v for v in shs.values() if len(v)>=2]
    # pick group whose farthest member is globally farthest from anchor
    best=None
    for v in grps:
        mx=max(cdist(c,A) for c in v)
        chgc=max(v,key=lambda c:cdist(c,A))
        if best is None or mx>best[0]: best=(mx,chgc)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if best:
        for r,cc in best[1][1]: out[r][cc]=tgt
    return out
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    p=solve(G[n+' input']); o=G[n+' output']
